• (a) Women of childbearing potential must:
• - Have a negative pregnancy test on the day of screening and on Day 1
• - Use one highly effective form of birth control for at least 28 days prior to Day 1 and agree to continue using one highly effective form of birth control through 60 days following administration of the second dose of study intervention. Periodic abstinence, the rhythm method, and withdrawal are NOT acceptable methods of contraception.
